Ringing Bounce Net.name: Ringing Bounce Net
Ringing Bounce Net.description: Signature move. Pairs of discs keep crossing between hard walls in a six-meter lane for two turns as the user renews the volley. A runner caught between two crossing banks takes force damage and is stunned for one turn. Each disc fades after three banks, and covering a wall with padding opens a gap. Strain: severe.
